description: This file provides a set of utility functions for API interactions with a backend server in a frontend application. It includes functions for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE), handling errors, managing authorization headers, and specific functions for working with work items, comments, and user data. It also manages authentication state and constructs URLs for API endpoints.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines whether a given URL path is public (no Authorization required) or protected.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds HTTP headers, adding Authorization for protected paths if available.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles non-OK HTTP responses, performs auto-logout for 401 errors on protected routes, and throws an Error with relevant message.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the backend, returning parsed JSON or null, with automatic auth handling.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Performs a POST request with JSON body, returning parsed JSON or throwing an error.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs a GET request with optional query parameters, returning parsed JSON or throwing an error.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Performs a PATCH request with JSON body, returning parsed JSON or throwing an error.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item identified by project_id and id.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a specific work item, sourcing the author ID from localStorage or using explicit parameter.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with provided properties, auto-including the creator's display name from localStorage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for a given API path.
